name: Smart Video Scheduler
description: An early content-calendar page with Calendar, Schedule and Analytics tabs and an AI Assist button. Scheduling itself is not available yet.
shortDescription: Content calendar page with Calendar, Schedule and Analytics tabs (preview).
fullDescription: Smart Video Scheduler (#/smart-video-scheduler, also opened by #/brightbean) is a preview of a content calendar. The page title reads 'Smart Video Scheduler' and an 'AI Assist' button sits at the top right. Three tabs switch the main area: Calendar shows 'Content Calendar - Your scheduled posts will appear here. Connect your social accounts to start scheduling.', Schedule shows 'Schedule Posts - Schedule your content for the best times. AI will suggest optimal posting times.' and Analytics shows 'Analytics - Track your post performance across all platforms.' Each tab is a placeholder message: there is no calendar grid, no way to add or schedule a post, no social account connection and no analytics data on this page yet. The AI Assist button asks the app to open an 'ai-caption-assistant' window, but no such window is registered, so clicking it currently shows nothing.
bestFor: People who want to see what the planned scheduling area will look like. For posting or scheduling content today, use the publishing options in the other studios.
whenToUse: You want to look at the planned content calendar, scheduling and analytics areas.
You were sent a link to #/smart-video-scheduler or #/brightbean and want to know what it is.
whenToUseAnother: Use Video Studio (#/video) or Image Studio (#/image) to make the content you want to post; their results have publishing options.
Use Smart Video Viral (#/viral) for short-form social video ideas and clips.
Use Library (#/library) to find content you already made.

featureExplanations.explanation: The tab that is open when the page loads. It shows 'Content Calendar' and the message 'Your scheduled posts will appear here. Connect your social accounts to start scheduling.'
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see where scheduled posts are meant to appear.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Placeholder only: no calendar grid or posts are shown, and there is no button on this page to connect social accounts.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click 'Schedule' to see 'Schedule Posts' and the message 'Schedule your content for the best times. AI will suggest optimal posting times.'
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see the planned scheduling area.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Placeholder only: you cannot pick content, a date or a time, and no posting times are suggested yet.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click 'Analytics' to see 'Analytics' and the message 'Track your post performance across all platforms.'
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see the planned performance area.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Placeholder only: no numbers or charts are shown.

featureExplanations.explanation: The 'AI Assist' button at the top right is meant to open an AI caption assistant.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Intended for writing post captions with AI.
featureExplanations.restrictions: The caption assistant window it asks for is not registered in the app, so clicking AI Assist currently does nothing visible.

howToUse: 1. Open #/smart-video-scheduler (or #/brightbean). 2. The Calendar tab is open by default. 3. Click Schedule or Analytics to switch tabs. 4. Each tab currently shows a short message only; scheduling, analytics and AI Assist are not working yet.
howToSteps: Click Schedule, then Analytics, to see the other tabs.
gettingStarted: Treat this page as a preview: nothing can be scheduled here yet.
Make your content in a studio such as Video Studio or Image Studio and publish it from there.
modelCapabilities: None. The page does not call any AI model; the AI Assist button opens nothing yet.
limitations: No calendar, scheduling or analytics data: all three tabs are placeholder messages.
No social account connection on this page, although the Calendar message mentions it.
The selected tab is not remembered; the page always opens on Calendar.

limitationDetails.impact: You cannot schedule, view or measure posts here.
limitationDetails.workaround: Create and publish content from the studios (for example Video Studio or Image Studio).
Write captions in a studio's own prompt or publishing tools.

troubleshooting: Clicking AI Assist does nothing: the caption assistant it opens is not available yet.
I see no posts in the Calendar: the calendar is not built yet; it always shows the 'Content Calendar' message.

steps: This is expected for now: the assistant window is not registered.
Write your caption in the studio you publish from instead.

commonProblems.problem: Cannot find a way to schedule a post
commonProblems.whyItHappens: Scheduling is not built on this page yet; the Schedule tab is a message only.
commonProblems.howToFix: Publish from the studio where you made the content.

useCases.title: Preview the planned scheduler
useCases.description: See the three areas the scheduler will have.
steps: Switch between Calendar, Schedule and Analytics
useCases.expectedOutput: Three short placeholder messages; nothing is saved or posted.

faqs.question: Can I schedule social posts here?
faqs.answer: Not yet. The Schedule tab only shows 'Schedule Posts - Schedule your content for the best times. AI will suggest optimal posting times.' There are no date, time or content controls.

faqs.question: How do I connect my social accounts?
faqs.answer: There is no connect button on this page, even though the Calendar message mentions it.

faqs.question: What does AI Assist do?
faqs.answer: It is meant to open an AI caption assistant, but that window is not available yet, so nothing happens when you click it.

faqs.question: What is #/brightbean?
faqs.answer: Another address for the same Smart Video Scheduler page.

glossary.Content calendar: A plan of which posts go out on which days.
glossary.Scheduling: Choosing a future date and time for a post to be published.

tips: Use this page as a preview only.
Publish content from the studio where you made it.
bestPractices: Do not rely on this page to post content; nothing is saved here.
